messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Buspirone is an anti-anxiety medicine.
Buspirone affects chemicals in the brain.
These chemicals may be unbalanced in people with anxiety.
Buspirone is used to treat symptoms of anxiety.
These symptoms include fear, tension, and irritability.
These symptoms also include dizziness and pounding heartbeat.
Other physical symptoms are also treated.
Buspirone is not an anti-psychotic medication.
It should not be used in place of medication prescribed by your doctor for psychotic disorders.
Triplet: ["Buspirone", "should not be used in place of", "medication prescribed by your doctor for psychotic disorders"]

The relation 'should not be used in place of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity should not be substituted for or used instead of the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'can be targeted by': The object entity is at risk of being misused or exploited by the subject entity.
C. 'has limitation': The subject document or guide has a limitation described by the object entity.
D. 'not caused by': The subject medical condition is not associated with the cause specified by the object entity.
E. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
